VERONA 2 MIN WHAT IS CULTURE? A shared pattern of beliefs, values, assumptions and behaviors that distinguish one group from another.
 Culture Transmitted
Culture is the sum of the “values, rituals, symbols, beliefs, and thought processes that are learned, shared by a group of people, and transmitted from generation to generation.”Geert Hofstede Cultural Transmission
